description: This Swift source file defines a class `AudioInputDeviceObserver` that monitors and manages the state of audio input devices on macOS using CoreAudio APIs. It includes methods to get default input device information, check device availability, start and stop listening for device changes, and handle device properties. The class interacts with system audio hardware to observe device status and updates.

classes.name: AudioInputDeviceObserver
classes.description: A class that observes changes in audio input devices on macOS and provides utility methods to query device information and monitor device state changes.

methods.name: defaultInputDeviceUID
methods.description: Returns the UID of the current default audio input device, if available.

methods.name: aliveInputDeviceUIDs
methods.description: Returns a set of UIDs for all alive input audio devices available in the system.

methods.name: hasUsableDefaultInputDevice
methods.description: Checks if there is a default input device that exists, is alive, and has input channels.

methods.name: defaultInputDeviceSummary
methods.description: Provides a human-readable summary of the default input device, including its name and UID.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts observing device change notifications; executes a callback when a change occurs.
